notes:
### Changed
- Light & Shadow tab is picture-first: a sky illustration (colour by time
  of day, sun on an east-west arc, house shadow) where the sun can be
  dragged to set the time; six one-click lighting moods with sky thumbnails
  (morning, noon, afternoon, evening, soft, flat bright without shadows);
  season chips (summer/rainy/winter); shadow switch; light and shadow-side
  sliders with icons. Exact time/date and "use sun for shading" moved to
  an Advanced section. Moods set time, light, dark and shadows together.
- Library window closes after picking a model so it can be placed right
  away (checkbox "Close window after picking" turns this off). The last
  category and search are restored when the window opens again.
